milestone: gft_xorpercep read off silicon for the FIRST TIME in the project's history. The operator table is complete: 8 of 8.

xorpercep.history: ABSENT since W977 -- first behind the 600 s cap, then the 1800 s cap, then a cable that had left the bus (W994). Four separate causes, each of which read as ABSENT and none of which was about the design.
xorpercep.what_it_took: the cap raised twice on measured slopes (W988, W997), the cable restored, and roughly 50 minutes of place-and-route in one build
xorpercep.clause_note: all four clauses real -- gft_xorpercep had 3 of 4 folded to constants until W984, and its ind clause was fed a non-representable LFSR word until W981

train1.reproduces: W988's word 0xa5a5317f exactly, at two placements it had not been read at before
train1.retracts: the W993 'unexplained regression' fully -- W994 identified the missing cable, and this is the confirmation that nothing about the design had changed

tool_behaviour_confirmed.summary_line: tri seeds: 1 placement(s) -- 1 pass, 0 fail, 0 with NO VERDICT; verdicts seen: 1111
tool_behaviour_confirmed.note: the three-state summary added in W994 reports correctly on a real pass, and the closing sentence still refuses to call one read a proof: 'the absence of a counterexample in 1 reads'
